chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Dating Armstrong band and leaving Henderson
summary: He left Armstrong in 1940 to join Red Allen, and left Henderson around 1932 from restlessness.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Going on after Fletcher Henderson's band, you went with Louis Russell and Louis Armstrong was heading the band. How long did you work with that band? And what year did you start working with that band?
I forget what year it was but I know what year I quit.
1940, New Year's, I joined Red Allen's band, Cafe Society.
Right. Do you know approximately when you left Fletcher Henderson's band?
... You left Lou Armstrong and went with Red Allen. I know he was with Lou Armstrong in 1936. Then I came to Cleveland in 1938 and you were still with Lou Armstrong. I mean I came to New York.
Could you approximate when he left Fletcher Henderson?
I didn't quit the band because I didn't like Lou. I just got tired of traveling.
Why did you leave Fletcher Henderson?
I was curious and I just liked to keep going.
He left Fletcher Henderson about 1932 or 3. About 1932 I believe.
That means you played with Fletcher Henderson's band for about two years?
But you say you joined Fletcher Henderson's band in 1930, after you had left Louis Russell? Is that correct?
I think that's correct because they played here in Cleveland in 1930 - in 1930 they played Cleveland.
I know when we came to Cleveland because that's when ...
